newsitem.title: FRANCE: French fiscal tightening may offset tax cuts.
newsitem.headline: French fiscal tightening may offset tax cuts.

text.p: The French government's tax overhaul announced on Thursday is not likely to do much to stimulate growth in light of overall fiscal tightening to meet European monetary union criteria, economists said.

"The global policy will be a tight fiscal policy," Eric Chaney of Morgan Stanley told Reuters Financial Television. "You cannot expect to boost growth when you really have to cut the budget deficit, which is the situation in this country.
Another economist noted that, when German taxes taxes fell by 20 billion francs last year, there was little impact on growth.
